description:
Keyword/code search over the Combined Nomenclature (or PRODCOM).

Returns ranked `{code, label, path}` candidates. Prefer
`resolve_product_code` for a one-call keyword-or-code helper; use this
directly if you specifically want the raw ranked candidate list.

lang.description: Language for translated labels in the response. One of: bg, cs, da, de, el, en, es, et, fi, fr, ga, hr, hu, it, lt, lv, mt, nl, pl, pt, ro, sk, sl, sv.

limit.description: Max number of candidates to return.

q.description: Keyword or code fragment to search for.

source.description: Nomenclature to search. A dotted PRODCOM code (e.g. '23.13') is auto-detected either way and reverse-mapped to CN codes.

name: search_codes
title: Search Codes
